# pve_firewall_group (Resource)

Firewall security group (cluster scope; rules are separate resources).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_firewall_group" "example" {
  group = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) Security Group name.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) <string>
- `rename` (String) Rename/update an existing security group. You can set 'rename' to the same value as 'name' to update the 'comment' of an existing group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: group (also the `terraform import` format).
